title: 1994 AMC 8 Problem 10
statement:
For how many positive integer values of \(N\) \((N \gt 0)\) is the expression

\[\frac{36}{N+2}\]

an integer?

solutions.text:
The expression is an integer when \(N+2\) divides \(36.\) The divisors of \(36\) are \(1,\) \(2,\) \(3,\) \(4,\) \(6,\) \(9,\) \(12,\) \(18,\) \(36.\)

Because \(N \gt 0,\) we need \(N + 2 \gt 2,\) leaving the divisors \(3,\) \(4,\) \(6,\) \(9,\) \(12,\) \(18,\) \(36\): that is \(7\) values.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: \(\dfrac{36}{N+2}\) is an integer exactly when \(N+2\) is a divisor of \(36\)
Since \(N \gt 0,\) only divisors of \(36\) that are greater than \(2\) count
